questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\text{解答}\ \ \text{令}\ y_{1}=(\tan x)^{\sin x},y_{2}=x^{x},\ \text{则}\ y^{\prime \prime}=y_{1}^{\prime}+y_{2}^{\prime}\ ,\ \ \ln y_{1}=\sin x\cdot \ln \tan x,\ \text{对}\ x\ \text{求导可得}\\&\frac{y_{1}^{\prime}}{y_{1}}=\cos x\cdot \ln \tan x+\sin x\cdot \frac{\sec^{2}x}{\tan x},\ \text{即}\ y_{1}^{\prime}=(\tan x)^{\sin x}\cdot (\cos x\cdot \ln \tan x+\sec x),\ \ \text{同理}\ \ln y_{2}=x\cdot \ln x,\ \text{则}\\&\frac{y_{2}^{\prime}}{y_{2}}=\ln x+1,y_{2}^{\prime}=x^{x}(1+\ln x),\\&\text{则有}\ y^{\prime}=(\tan x)^{\sin x}\cdot (\cos x\cdot \ln \tan x+\sec x)+x^{x}(1+\ln x)\end{aligned}
